Publisher readiness

Setup checks for the site owner. Journey approval and traffic eligibility are not yet verified.

Eligibility
Not verified
Analytics
No connected GA4 evidence
Article landmarks
58 of 58

This checks generated files; it does not read a private analytics or publisher account. Source guidance checked October 19, 2026.

Owner checklist

  1. Connect the correct GA4 property. In Analytics, open Admin → Data streams → Web for this domain. Confirm its measurement ID and account access. A new tag needs a reviewed analytics consent choice, withdrawal control and privacy disclosure. Create and connect a GA4 web stream · Google consent-mode implementation
  2. Verify the audience. Use a real 30-day GA4 report. Journey lists 1,000 premium-market sessions, with the US, Canada, UK and Australia among the qualifying countries. Visitors, pageviews and sessions are different metrics; the provider makes the eligibility decision. Journey minimum requirements · Mediavine and Journey requirements
  3. Review the publication. Check article originality, sources, image permissions, About, contact/corrections and the owner-specific privacy policy. Automated checks cannot establish editorial quality or legal compliance.
  4. Apply through the publisher portal. The owner connects GA4 and submits site details at Mediavine’s official portal. No application has been submitted by this tool. Journey application and launch
  5. Plan the ad-network transition. Current Adsterra code is preserved. Journey requires exclusive programmatic inventory; remove the old provider’s scripts and placements in an approved transition before launch. Affiliate links and properly disclosed direct sponsorship are separate. Moving from an existing ad network
  6. Complete owner onboarding. Review the agreement, confirm site details, install only the account-issued wrapper and ads.txt, and complete required Stripe identity verification personally. Nothing here accepts terms or supplies identity. Journey application and launch · Journey script on a custom-built site · Journey ads.txt for custom sites
  7. Test before launch. Confirm consent, mobile reading, keyboard access, page speed and stable ad space. On an approved installation, use the provider’s ?test=placeholders procedure and inspect real article placements. Leave placement selectors at their defaults unless a verified targeting problem calls for a change. Ad placement selector guidance

Custom article layout

Public long-form blog and news bodies use one .journey-content landmark. Navigation, related-page layouts and interactive tools are outside that target. This is a targeting aid, not proof that ads work. No sidebar selector is supplied because this release has not verified a static ad-safe sidebar.

Keep ad slots outside animated, transformed or clipped surfaces. Do not insert ads inside component pickers, forms, diagrams or 3D controls. Journey guidance for custom layouts

Keep the measurement honest

Record qualifying sessions, source countries, date range and property separately from reader engagement and revenue. Never publish private notes, build tokens or search text as event parameters. This report contains no traffic, ranking or revenue estimate.
